run_test_evaluation: run the test evaluation script with a config file and optional CLI overrides
run_main_with_config: run the main function with an OmegaConf DictConfig to evaluate a model on test data
load_model_from_config: load a model from config using load_from_config with static assets from the dataset
load_checkpoint_for_model: load a checkpoint into the model using load_checkpoint with the modules dict
run_test_with_loader: run the test function with a DataLoader, loss function, and summary function to compute loss means
